इष्ट p. p. [इष् इच्छायां कर्मणि क्त]
1
Wished, desired, longed for,
wished for; उपपन्नो गुणैरिष्टैः

fond of
sons.
--3 Worshipped, reverenced,
--4
Respected.
--5 Approved, regarded
as good.
--6 Desirable; see इष्टापूर्त.
--7 Valid.
--8 Sacrificed,
worshipped with sacrifices.
--9 Supposed
(कल्पित); oft. used in Līlāvatī.
--ष्टः
1 A lover, husband, beloved
person; इष्टप्रवासजनितानि Ś. 4. 2.
--2 A friend;

; 2. 167.
--3
N. of a tree (एरंड).
--4 N. of Viṣṇu.
--5 A sacrifice.
--ष्टा N. of a tree (शमी).
--ष्टं
1 Wish, desire.
--2 A holy
ceremony or संस्कार.
--3 A sacrifice; see
इष्टापूर्त. --ind. Voluntarily.
--Comp.
--अर्थः desired object. ˚उद्युक्त a.
zealously engaged in gaining one's
desired object.
--आपत्तिः f. occurrence
of what is desired; a statement by
a debater which is favourable to his
opponent also; इष्टापत्तौ दोषांतरमाह
Jag.
--कर्मन् n. (In arith.) rule of
supposition, operation with an
assumed number.
--कापथः the root
of a fragrant grass (वीरणमूल).
--कामदुह् a. granting the desired
objects, an epithet of the cow of
plenty.
--गंध a. fragrant.
--(धः) any
fragrant substance.
--(धं) sand.
--जनः
a beloved person (whether man
or woman);

.
--देवः, --देवता a
favourite god, one's tutelary deity.
--यामन् a. going according to one's
desire.
--व्रत a. {1} performing
desired vows. {2} obeying one's
wish. {3} (food &c.) for the
fulfilment of a vow. {4} that by which
good works succeed.

इष्टापूर्तं [इष्टं च पूर्तं च तयोः समाहारः
पूर्वपददीर्घत्वं] Performance of pious
or charitable deeds; performing
sacrifices, and digging wells and
doing other acts of charity;
इष्टापूर्तविधेः सपत्नशमनात्

;
वापीकूपतडागादिदेवतायतनानि च ।
[]
अन्नप्रदानमारामाः पूर्तमर्थ्याः प्रचक्षते ॥
एकाग्निकर्महवनं त्रेतायां यच्च हूयते । अंतर्वेद्यां च
यद्दानमिष्टं तदभिधीयते ॥.

इष्टिः f. [इष्-क्तिन्]
1 Wish,
request, desire.
--2 Seeking,
striving to get.
--3 Any desired object.
--4 A desired rule or desideratum;
(a term used with reference to
Patañjali's additions to Kātyāyana's
Vārtikas; इष्टयो भाष्यकारस्य,

ा &c., cf. उपसंख्यान).
--5
Impulse, hurry.
--6 Invitation, order.
--7 (यज्-क्तिन्) A sacrifice.
--8 An
oblation consisting of butter, food
&c.
--Comp.
--अयनं a sacrifice
lasting for a long time.
--पचः {1} a
miser. {2} a demon; an Asura;
so ˚मुष्.
--पशु an animal to be
killed at a sacrifice.

.
--2 A brick used
in preparing the sacrificial altar &c.
--Comp.
--गृहं a brick house.
--चयनं
collecting fire by means of a brick.
--चित a. made of bricks;

;
also इष्टकचित.
--न्यासः laying the
foundation of a house.
--पथः a
road made of bricks.
--राशिः a pile
of bricks.
